title: Rodrigo Duterte camp tells ICC no crimes against humanity in PH

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s camp on Thursday argued before the International Criminal Court (ICC) that no crimes against humanity were committed during the relevant period in this case. They noted that the Philippines’ homicide rate at the time was lower than the global average and even at par with that of the United States. The argument was contained in a 77-page pretrial filing by Duterte, in which he, through his counsel, Peter Haynes, said that none of the five elements of crimes against humanity applied to the country’s situation under his administration.
